 SELECT store_id, 'cur' w, v, sf FROM sl WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31'

n AS (SELECT w, sum(v) s, sum(CASE WHEN sf THEN v ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN store_id NOT IN (136,137) THEN v ELSE 0 END) s_ex FROM x GROUP BY w),

 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' AND net_amount<=0) nonpos
FROM fact_return_line

WITH lfl_store AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store
  WHERE store_id BETWEEN 100 AND 899 AND store_id <> 129
),
sales AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'base' END AS win, f.net_amount AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN lfl_store l ON l.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-05' AND DATE '2025-06-01'
),
returns AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'base' END AS win, -r.refund_net AS amount
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN lfl_store l ON l.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-05' AND DATE '2025-06-01'
),
tot AS (SELECT win, sum(amount) net_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM returns) GROUP BY win)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period,
  round(100 * (max(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE win='cur') / max(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE win='base') - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM tot
